# MakePDFRight

> Fast, private, and secure online PDF & AI toolkit. All file processing happens locally in the browser or via secure serverless handlers with automatic file deletion.

## Core Tools

- [Merge PDF](/merge): Combine multiple PDF files into a single document in any order.
- [Split PDF](/split): Extract specific pages or page ranges from PDF files.
- [Compress PDF](/compress): Reduce PDF file size while maintaining optimum document quality.
- [PDF to Word](/pdf-to-word): Convert PDF files into editable Microsoft Word (.docx) documents.
- [PDF to Excel](/pdf-to-excel): Extract tables and structured data from PDF into Microsoft Excel (.xlsx) spreadsheets.
- [PDF to JPG](/pdf-to-jpg): Convert every PDF page into high-resolution JPG images.
- [Image to PDF](/image-to-pdf): Convert JPG, PNG, WEBP, and BMP images into PDF documents.
- [Edit PDF](/edit): Modify text, add images, drawings, signatures, and annotations directly in your browser.
- [Rotate PDF](/rotate): Rotate individual or all PDF pages to correct orientation.
- [Organize PDF](/organise): Rearrange, rotate, delete, extract, and insert pages in PDF files.
- [AI Image Generator](/generate-image): Generate custom high-quality images from text prompts using Gemini AI models.
- [Audio Transcription](/transcribe): Transcribe voice recordings and audio files into accurate text.
